_comment: Free things for kids and families across India.

items.name: ASI monuments — free for under-15s
items.blurb: Children under 15 get free entry at every Archaeological Survey of India monument — forts, tombs and ancient sites across the country.

items.name: Gurdwara langar
items.blurb: Every Sikh gurdwara serves a free vegetarian meal, the langar, to anyone who visits — no questions asked.

items.name: India Gate lawns
items.blurb: Free green space in the heart of Delhi — picnics, kite flying and ice-cream carts after sunset.

items.name: Marine Drive
items.blurb: Mumbai's free seafront promenade, best at sunset with the Queen's Necklace of lights switching on.

items.name: Cubbon Park
items.blurb: 300 free acres of gardens, walking trails and old trees right in the middle of Bengaluru.

items.name: Lodi Gardens
items.blurb: Free Mughal-era tombs and gardens, a favourite spot for morning walks and picnics.

items.name: Your local public library
items.blurb: Free membership at most government libraries, from state central libraries to district reading rooms. Ask about story sessions for kids.

items.name: parkrun India
items.blurb: Free, timed 5 km runs and walks every Saturday morning, open to every age and pace.

items.name: National Digital Library of India
items.blurb: Free online access to millions of books, videos and courses for school and college students.

items.name: Prasar Bharati / DD kids shows
items.blurb: India's free-to-air public broadcaster carries cartoons, stories and cultural programmes for children.

items.name: Atal Tinkering Labs
items.blurb: Free hands-on STEM labs — 3D printers, robotics kits and more — set up in thousands of schools nationwide.

items.name: India's public beaches
items.blurb: Free to walk, paddle and build sandcastles, from Goa's shores to Chennai's Marina Beach and Kerala's coast.
